Comparatives and superlatives: Adjetivos curtos formam o comparativo com -er (taller) e o superlativo com the -est (the tallest); adjetivos longos usam more e the most (more interesting, the most intelligent). Há formas irregulares: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst. A estrutura as ... as indica igualdade.
Second conditional: O Second Conditional fala de situações hipotéticas ou improváveis no presente ou no futuro: if + Simple Past, would + verbo base (If I won the lottery, I would travel the world). Com o verbo to be usa-se were para todas as pessoas na linguagem formal (If I were you...).
